accounting.adjacency: add/remove one client contribution; absent slot is zero; roster and weights fixed
limitations: only noised global-model transcript is covered
accounting.privacy_unit: one participating client's complete local dataset slot

noise_seed_rule: private trusted-decryptor seed + round derivation; seed artifact excluded from public metrics

privacy_config.adjacency_definition: Replace one fixed-roster client's contribution by zero while keeping the roster and every public weight unchanged; all other client slots are identical.
privacy_config.key_ownership: trusted decryptor owns the CKKS secret key; clients and server receive public encryption context
privacy_config.noise_placement: one Gaussian vector after trusted decryption of the homomorphic weighted sum
privacy_config.noise_rng_assumption: ideal independent Gaussian samples; reproducible PRNG seed is stored in the private artifact directory and not suitable as a production CSPRNG claim
privacy_config.privacy_unit: one participating client's complete local dataset slot
privacy_config.release_set: validation-selected global checkpoints and their post-processing validation metrics; no clean aggregates, individual updates, client counts, noise seeds, or unclipped diagnostics
privacy_config.threat_model: server cannot decrypt individual ciphertexts; the trusted decryptor is honest, does not collude with the server, sees the clean aggregate, and is excluded from the DP guarantee

selection_note: Round selection uses only the validation split, which is not client data; selecting among released models is post-processing.
